clubLineagePolicy.renamedOrRelocated: Contested sporting-identity continuity cases (e.g. Wimbledon -> Milton Keynes Dons in 2004, and reformed AFC Wimbledon) are stored as distinct clubId records (wimbledon, milton-keynes-dons, afc-wimbledon) rather than silently aliasing clubs across identities.
clubLineagePolicy.historicalSplit: Aldershot (pre-1992 Football League club, folded 1992) and Aldershot Town (post-2008 League Two entrant) are likewise separated by distinct clubIds (aldershot vs. aldershot-town).
